prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Assembling Your Desktop Pet", "Your companion is currently being generated and configured for your desktop environment."]
1: ["Find Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Answer 2 quick questions to discover which pet personality matches your desktop routine."]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's Personality & Appearance", "Select the companion archetype that best fits your daily desktop environment."]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Use quick keyboard shortcuts to summon, hide, or chat with your pet anytime on your desktop.", "Launch to Desktop"]
4: ["Preparing desktop graphics and interaction models..."]
5: ["Generating Your Pet in Background", "Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a system tray alert the moment your pet arrives.", "Desktop Notification Enabled"]
6: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Build a unique pet that lives directly on your desktop, ready to assist and keep you company.", "Start Journey"]
7: ["Adoption Official!", "Your companion certificate is sealed. You have unlocked the Founding Companion Badge!", "Founding Companion Badge Unlocked"]
8: ["Sign in with 1-click SSO to safeguard your custom pet across app updates and re-installs.", "Instant 1-Click Sign In Available"]
9: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion", "Click your pet to interact, right-click for settings, or use Ctrl+Shift+P to instantly hide or reveal it on screen.", "Got It!"]
